entries.title: Tecmo World Wrestling
entries.summary: Tecmo's wrestling game: pick one of ten fictional international wrestlers and beat the rest of the roster, then the final boss 'The Earl of Doom' Blue King.
entries.why_it_matters: The first wrestling game with a play-by-play announcer (Tom Talker, in text bubbles) and possibly the first with action-replay cutscenes for signature moves.
entries.gameplay_notes: Walk into an opponent to grapple, then use pad and button combos for more than 20 moves per wrestler. Aerial, ground and running attacks. Win by pin, submission or count-out. Between matches, button-mashing training raises damage; losing a match costs a training level.

entries.content_notes: The near-literal translation gives some Engrish, such as 'Northern Right Suplex'.

entries.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
entries.summary: Konami's 1989 action-platformer from Ultra Games: the four Turtles rescue April and Splinter from Shredder across New York, from the sewers to the Technodrome.
entries.why_it_matters: A major commercial success: Nintendo Power readers' game of the year, and Computer Entertainer's NES Game of the Year for 1989.
entries.gameplay_notes: Overhead city maps lead to side-scrolling interiors. Swap between turtles, each with a different weapon reach and power. Captured turtles can be rescued from stage three on. Six missions, including the Hudson River Dam, where you disable bombs. Sub-weapons include shuriken, boomerangs and the Kiai scroll.

entries.title: Wurm: Journey to the Center of the Earth
entries.summary: Cyclone System's multi-genre game from Asmik: 18-year-old Moby leads a drilling-vehicle crew investigating mysterious 1999 earthquakes, and is caught up in an underground war between the Nonmalta and the Dinamur.
entries.gameplay_notes: Side-scrolling vehicle travel, overhead shooting, on-foot ruin exploration (kick, jump, gun) and first-person boss fights, where you must raise a probability meter to 100% before you can finish the boss. Run out of fuel or energy and you lose. New crew members join along the way.
